en.headline: Second domestic large cruise ship Adora Flora City arrives at Kai Tak
en.dek: China's second domestically built large cruise ship, carrying more than 3,800 passengers, arrived at Kai Tak Cruise Terminal on its maiden commercial voyage from Guangzhou.
body: The Adora Flora City, China's second domestically built large cruise ship, arrived at the Kai Tak Cruise Terminal on Monday morning during its maiden commercial voyage.

The vessel departed from Guangzhou Nansha International Cruise Home Port on Sunday with more than 3,800 passengers on a six-day, five-night itinerary that includes a stop in Hong Kong before heading to Vietnam.

Measuring 341 metres with a capacity of 5,232 passengers and 2,130 cabins, the ship is the sister vessel of the Adora Magic City. Operators said it will use Hong Kong as a home port for nearly 20 voyages in 2027.

zh.headline: 第二艙國產大型郵輪愛達・花城號抵達啟德郵輪碼頭
zh.dek: 中國第二艙國產大型郵輪載逾3800名旅客，於商業首航期間今早抵達啟德郵輪碼頭。
body: 第二艙國產大型郵輪「愛達・花城號」於周一早上抵達啟德郵輪碼頭，展開商業首航行程。
該郵輪周日從廣州南沙國際郵輪母港出發，載逾3800名旅客，航程六天五夜，途經香港後前往越南。
郵輪全長341米，可載5232人，設2130間客房，為愛達・魔都號姊妹船。營運方表示，2027年將以香港為母港營運近20個航次。
